name: Forest Park
title: Full-Stack / Product Engineer
summary: Full-stack developer who builds complete products, not slices of them - database design through admin and end-user UI, payments, and go-live. Founded and runs a multi-tenant SaaS in production (Stripe Billing + Connect, Cloudflare Workers, Postgres), led an AI-powered medical education platform to ~1,000 active users across North American schools, and delivered an NFC networking app ~1 month early at ~20% under budget.

highlights: Founded and built a multi-tenant SaaS client portal for photography studios end to end: subdomain-per-studio tenancy, magic-link auth, booking/availability, galleries, and print orders.
Implemented Stripe Billing for studio subscriptions and Stripe Connect for client payments, with direct charges routed to each studio's own account.
Shipped on an edge-first stack - Cloudflare Workers + Hono API, Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL, R2 for gallery assets, Fly.io - and runs it in production today.
experience.stack: React 19, TanStack Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers, Hono, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Fly.io, Stripe Billing, Stripe Connect, Cloudflare R2.

highlights: Own frontend architecture and technical strategy across multiple product initiatives, steering teams toward scalable, maintainable delivery.
Run performance audits and ship the optimizations that follow, improving page load and Core Web Vitals in support of both UX and organic search.
Lead technical SEO - meta, structured data, and site architecture - for stronger organic visibility.
Led architecture and development of an AI-powered OSCE exam preparation platform adopted by schools across North America to train medical students, nurses, and dental assistants.
Owned the stack end to end - database design through admin and student frontends; the platform reached ~1,000 active users.
Built an analytics dashboard tracking student progress across multiple dimensions: case completion, assessment scores, and actionable insights for instructors.
experience.stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Stripe.

highlights: Developed technical proposals for project RFPs, covering architecture, scope, delivery plans, estimates, timelines, integrations, and security requirements.
Evaluated stakeholder needs and translated business goals into technical requirements and implementation specifications.
Discussed implementation approaches, costs, and technical tradeoffs with executives and prospective clients to guide scope and delivery decisions.
Led migration to an external state manager, cutting load times ~50% for 10,000+ active users.
Built data-visualization dashboards that turned large, multi-horizon datasets into decisions for cross-functional teams.

Delivered an Excel-like tendering and cost-tracking web experience - per-cell input, familiar grid workflows - supporting cost tracking across multiple projects and material costs by vendor and project, replacing spreadsheet handoffs.
experience.stack: Next.js, React, React Native, Tailwind CSS, Go, SvelteKit.

highlights: Implemented MQTT broker endpoints for real-time device communication across distributed hardware.
Built custom Angular pipes for complex data streams, reducing duplication and improving developer speed.
Drove Atomic Design and Storybook adoption for a shared component library and faster UI delivery.
Aligned shareholders and engineers on design and development standards, delegated work, and ran delivery for junior developers.
Built health data charts over bed-sensor streams to surface sleep and health metrics in the app.
Implemented GraphQL endpoints and the React Native UI to match stakeholder requirements end to end.
experience.stack: React Native, GraphQL, Apollo Server, MongoDB, serverless, AWS.

highlights: Redesigned and rebuilt EMCO Energy's public website and CMS dashboard from the ground up.
Partnered closely with stakeholders to meet feature requirements and design standards.
experience.stack: Next.js, Express, MongoDB, Prisma, PostgreSQL, PlanetScale (stack evolved per project).

highlights: Shipped a full-stack NFC scanner/writer app for STEM education on Android and iOS.
Built VR experiences communicating the scale of Alberta solar and wind farms, including a 1:1 representation of a major North American solar project.
